design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 (self_pay_visit_packages, category package)

0. DRAW AND SCOPE SNAPSHOT
draw_counts.py --task 0 printed: {"task": 0, "key": "env_0032_physical_therapy_clinic_network/self_pay_visit_packages/0", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 4, 4]}. Assignment: package_ext_unfreeze_extension 5, package_ext_renewal_purchase 5, package_ext_installment_catch_up 4, package_ext_household_transfer 4 (root).
Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0). Claimed here: the four policies above and tools draft_package_installment_97c9f1d1, unfreeze_visit_package_d2f7d693, purchase_visit_package_a542d834, transfer_package_visits_0bb17a94 (owner=user). Reserved for task 1 (draw: 1 prerequisite, factor counts [6, 6]): the cancellation-for-refund flow (patient's own confirmation, owner=user) and the reinstatement of an expired package - distinct base subjects (package_cancelled/visits_refunded, package_reinstated) that no tool of this task writes. The blueprint names three patient-own acts (cancellation confirmation, withdrawal, billing dispute); withdrawal and dispute carry no computable quantity in the schema, so the two user tools of the difficulty are the cancellation confirmation (task 1) and the transfer, which base package_evt_transfers itself calls 'the holder's own decision' (task 0).

1. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST
Renee Okafor asks one thing: give her leftover package visits to her son Marcus. Nothing she says names an installment, a freeze or a purchase. The agent must read the transfer policy and discover three prerequisite sentences, check each against records (frozen giving package, installment 3 unpaid, Marcus holding no active package), resolve them in topological order and then compute a visit count that four keep-back rules reduce from the standing balance. Difficulty comes from policy reading, ledger reconciliation across two patients and cross-category reads (series, plan of care, wellness membership), not from tool choice: each problem has exactly one task tool.

2. PROBLEM-TREE CARD
Root: package_ext_household_transfer (tool transfer_package_visits_0bb17a94, owner user).
Edges (from -> to; kind; gate; form; prerequisite sentence; condition; resolver/owner; why false at frozen_time):
 E1 transfer -> package_ext_unfreeze_extension; state_gate; visit_packages.status; state; "Visits are not transferred until the giving package's freeze is lifted and it stands in active status." (negated direction - a transfer is 'not made until'); condition status active + freeze_reason none; resolver unfreeze_visit_package_d2f7d693 (agent); false: initial_state.visit_packages.<G>.status = frozen, freeze_reason = surgery. Only the unfreeze write lifts a freeze (reinstatement acts on expired packages), so the state singles out one write.
 E2 transfer -> package_ext_renewal_purchase; state_gate; visit_packages.status (recipient); state; "Visits are not transferred until the recipient holds an active package of their own, bought and paid for." condition: recipient package active with a paid installment; resolver purchase_visit_package_a542d834 (agent); false: Marcus's Core 8 status expired, Recovery 6 status exhausted. Only the sale creates a bought-and-paid package for a patient.
 E3 transfer -> package_ext_installment_catch_up; value_input; binding balance; state; "Before the transferable balance is worked out, every installment of the giving package whose due date has passed must stand paid in the package's history." (affirmative); resolver draft_package_installment_97c9f1d1 (agent); false: installments_total 3, payments only for installments 1 (2026-06-12) and 2 (2026-07-12); installment 3 due 2026-08-11. Only the installment collection books an installment payment on an existing package (the sale books one only on the new package it creates).
 E4 package_ext_unfreeze_extension -> package_ext_installment_catch_up; value_input; binding standing_days; state; "The expiry extension on unfreezing is fixed only after the package's history carries an installment payment for every installment whose due date has passed;" (affirmative, 'fixed only after'); same evidence as E3.
Four-point test per sentence: ordering connective present (not until / before / only after); the waited-on side is a record-visible state (status and freeze reason, an active paid package, installment payments in the history); no tool, policy id or code token; scope exact (every past-due installment; the giving package; the recipient's own package). The charter mixes negated sentences (transfer, a release-type act) and affirmative ones (figures that are 'fixed only after' / 'worked out' after).
Topological order: installment_catch_up -> unfreeze_extension -> renewal_purchase -> household_transfer (the sale may sit anywhere before the transfer; it touches only Marcus's new package, so order_uniqueness holds).
Deletion sensitivity (actual runs of _tmp_author/calc.py, skip set {8}): unfreeze result 66 -> 10; transfer result 8 -> 0. E1/E2 change the terminal state (package stays frozen with expiry 2027-06-12 / no recipient package exists).
value_input edges: 2 (E3, E4) >= max(3-1, 1) = 2. The owner=user write is the transfer: the holder herself moves the visits once the agent hands the tool over with the package, recipient and count.
No user hint: the persona's reactions to 'amount owed', 'come off its hold' and 'Marcus needs an active package' fire only after the agent says so; no policy/tool id appears.
Tools block nothing: no task tool reads status, installments or recipient state to refuse; the transfer writes even if the giving package were frozen.

3. BASE-INVARIANT CARD
- draft (subjects package_payment_received, package_visits_credited): package_evt_payments_and_crediting, no structured eligibility (policy_scope): card accepted; installment credits visits_included / installment_count = 24/3 = 8. Overwrite declared on 'the purchase price is split into installment_count equal installments (the last absorbing any cent of rounding)'.
- unfreeze (package_unfrozen): package_freeze_rules (policy_scope): only active packages are frozen (Renee's was frozen from active on 2026-08-03, freezes_used 1 of 2), freeze_extends_expiry true. Overwrites declared on the day-count clause and the 'lasts at most freeze_max_days' clause.
- sale (package_purchased, package_activated, package_payment_received, package_visits_credited): package_agg_multi_holding (Marcus has 0 open packages), package_purchase_eligibility gates no_medicare_plan (Marcus's only plan of care is Commercial PPO, status discharged - no Medicare plan; correlation care_plans.customer_id = customer_id) and surgery_window (time gate; anchor visit_packages.surgery_date; not_after; variants.surgery_window_days; calendar days, surgery date = day zero, inclusive) - the Recovery tier has post_surgical_protocol_required false and surgery_date '' on file, bound to the surgery_date argument ''; boundary cases recorded in temporal_feasibility. In-network same-diagnosis clause: Marcus's PPO plan for S93.401A is discharged for benefits_exhausted and the tier's benefit_exhausted_exception is true. Guardian clause: Marcus is 16 (< 18); his mother is the buyer on the call. package_renewal_pricing overwritten clause by clause (one discount -> total discount, renewal discount, member discount, non-stacking). Expiry = purchase date + validity_days 120 = 2027-02-02.
- transfer (package_visits_transferred, package_visits_credited): package_evt_transfers gate transfer_from_active (state: active; evidence prior_step 10 changes status to active; correlation visit_packages.package_id = package_id). Comprehensive tier: transfer_allowed true, household (same mailing address on file: both profiles postal_code 27410; Renee confirms they live together), transfer_min_visits 4 (16 standing), transfers_per_package 1 (none made from this package). Overwrite declared on 'All remaining visits move together;'.

4. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
Giving package G (Comprehensive 24, frozen). Its ledger: payments 752.00 (inst 1, card, 2026-06-12) and 752.00 (inst 2, card, 2026-07-12); credits 8, 8 and a transfer-in of 2 (2026-06-20, source = Marcus's Core 8 transfer entry); 10 redemptions (standard visits 2026-06-15 .. 2026-07-23, each matching a series attendance). Series SR (Standard 45-Minute, package-funded, paused 2026-08-03 surgery_pending, 2 per week, 2 appointments still booked: 16 booked - 10 attended - 1 timely cancellation (2026-07-06, 30 h notice) - 2 no-shows (07-20, 07-27) - 1 clinic cancellation (07-30)). Two no-shows equal the forfeit grace (2) so no forfeit is owed; fewer than the series release threshold (3), so no series release is owed. Plan PP (Commercial PPO, active, opened 2026-08-20, Z47.1) - Renee's post-op rehab. Marcus: MC8 (Core 8, expired 2026-07-31, 6 used, 2 transferred to Renee), MO (Recovery 6, exhausted 2026-09-22, 6 used, no forfeits), MP (PPO for S93.401A, discharged 2026-07-15 benefits_exhausted), MM (Performance Membership, active since 2025-06-01). Marcus's patient reference number is reachable only through the transfer-in credit's source entry (the customers finder is used once, for the caller).

5. FACTOR CARDS (tier taken; evidence; baseline figure from the sensitivity run)
installment_catch_up (expected 664.48, all-baseline 752.00): medical_hold_allowance (method) surgery freeze, due 2026-08-11 >= freeze start 2026-08-03 -> 5.00 x 9 weeks = 45.00, baseline 709.48; card_history_allowance 2 card installments -> 1% = 7.52, baseline 672.00; clinic_disruption_credit (series) 1 clinic cancellation -> 10.00, baseline 674.48; insured_transition_credit (plan) active plan opened 2026-08-20 -> 25.00, baseline 689.48. Near-miss: the 2026-07-06 cancellation is a patient cancellation (work_conflict), not clinic_cancelled.
unfreeze_extension (66, all-baseline 60): freeze_day_count (method, series) paused on the freeze start and no visit since -> inclusive 64, baseline 65; freeze_cap (plan) 90, baseline 62; rebooking_allowance 2/week -> 7, baseline 59; closure_credit 1 -> 2, baseline 64; noshow_deduction 2 -> 7, baseline 73. Near-miss: the latest visit used (2026-07-23) is before the freeze, so the 'visit used during the freeze' tier does not apply.
renewal_purchase (432.90, all-baseline 599.40): renewal_discount (multi-source) 13 days, no forfeits -> 10, baseline 452.88; member_tenure 491 days -> 15, baseline 452.88; continuation_discount (plan, multi-source) benefits_exhausted 82 days -> 12, baseline 566.10; discount_combination (method) all three added = 37, baseline 566.10; discount_cap 6/6 attended -> 35, baseline 419.58. Near-miss: the expired Core 8 (M22.2X1) is not the exhausted same-tier package and is a different diagnosis.
household_transfer (8, all-baseline 16): booked_appointment_keepback (method, series) series paused -> its bookings stand suspended and one week of the standing schedule (visits_per_week 2) is kept back, baseline 10; return_assessment_keepback (multi-source) 74 days -> 2, baseline 10; received_transfer_keepback 2 received 107 days ago -> 2, baseline 10; noshow_reserve (series) 2 no-shows = grace -> 2, baseline 10.
Per task: multi-source factors renewal_discount, continuation_discount, return_assessment_keepback; cross-difficulty factors on series and plan.

6. PERSONA DESIGN
A teacher on a lunch break: brisk, practical, warm. Opening = surface goal only. Credentials verbatim (3365550147, 1979-03-22, PM-3304718 if asked). Must-ask answers prepared: son's name and birthday, relationship and same address, which package for Marcus (the same six-visit one), how to pay (card), clinic (the one on his records). Passive reactions: pays owed amounts by card after hearing the figure, agrees to lift the freeze, agrees to buy the six-visit package, runs the transfer herself with the agent's figures, closes when told the visits moved. She never volunteers a number the agent must compute.

7. STANDARD SOLUTION (evaluation_criteria)
0 find_customers(phone) - 1 verify(DOB, phone) - 2 find_visit_packages(Renee) - 3 find_package_events(G) - 4 find_appointment_series(Renee) - 5 find_series_events(SR) - 6 find_care_plans(Renee) - 7/8 unlock+call draft (amount 664.48, installment 3, card, 8 visits) - 9/10 unlock+call unfreeze (66 days) - 11 find_package_events(source entry) - 12 find_visit_packages(Marcus) - 13 find_package_events(Marcus) - 14 find_care_plans(Marcus) - 15 find_wellness_memberships(Marcus) - 16/17 unlock+call purchase (432.90, member, 35%, expiry 2027-02-02) - 18/19 unlock_user + call_user transfer (8 visits to the new package).

8. VERIFICATION
Commands (repo root): check_extended / check_task_tools / replay_tasks / check_solvability / check_compute / check_grounding / check_cross_fire with --task 0 - all OK (EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK 57/57 closure rows, SOLVABILITY OK 9 base gates, COMPUTE OK 4 computations 18 factors, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK). Authoring evaluator _tmp_author/calc.py reuses check_compute.build_env/eval_compute on the handling-time world and printed: installment 664.48 (baseline 752.0), unfreeze 66 (60), purchase 432.9 (599.4), transfer 8 (16); skipping step 8: unfreeze 10, transfer 0.
Revisions: (a) transfer factor 'forfeit reserve' was decorative because two no-shows within the grace of 2 forfeit nothing and a third miss would also trigger a series release (an obligation no task carries); replaced by the no-show reserve keyed to the grace. (b) seed FK fields on the series set to null instead of '' (replay flagged '' as dangling). (c) a module-level helper in task_tools.py was read as a tool; inlined.

9. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT
From the transfer rule the agent learns three waits; the records show the frozen status, the missing installment 3 and Marcus's lack of an active package; the installment rule gives 752.00 less 45.00, 7.52, 10.00 and 25.00 = 664.48; the unfreeze rule gives 64 days (inclusive), uncapped by 90, +7 +2 -7 = 66; the sale rule gives 37% capped at 35% of 666.00 = 432.90; the transfer rule gives 16 - 2 - 2 - 2 - 2 = 8. These agree with gold.

10. KNOWN LIMITS / ROUTE-AROUNDS
The blueprint keeps the base charter frozen; extended policies add business rules on top through declared overwrites. The member discount reads the Wellness Membership category (not a difficulty); the cross-difficulty factors of this task read series and plan records.


11. REWORK ROUND 2 (policy-task audit env/.../audits/policy_task/self_pay_visit_packages/, first revision)
- F-1 (SOURCE-POLICY RED, undeclared override): symptom - base 'The purchase price is the list price of the new tier less one discount.' stayed in force while the extended rule adds discounts (566.10 vs 432.90 for Marcus). Root cause - overwrite listed three base clauses, not this one. Change - package_ext_renewal_purchase.overwrite now declares it, replaced_by 'The purchase price is the list price reduced once by the total discount percentage and rounded to the cent.' (already a sentence of the rule). Re-run: purchase_price 432.90 unchanged, single reading.
- F-2 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED, booked_appointment_keepback was a share substitution): change - the paused tier now keeps back one week of the series' standing schedule (visits_per_week, new binding series_weekly) in place of the suspended bookings, while the active/booked tier counts the bookings; the two tiers read different quantities, so the factor is a genuine method. Rule sentence, compute_basis and ladder rewritten together. Re-run on this world: booked keep-back 2 (was 1); transfer visits 9 -> 8; per-factor baselines 10/10/10/10; all-baseline 16; skipping the installment collection -> 0. GT step 19 visits, tracing, computations, closure texts updated.
- O-2: freeze-day count tier now reads the series pause_start_date without requiring the series to be paused now (rule: 'was paused on or before the freeze start date'); Renee's series is paused, value unchanged (66).
- O-3: renewal continuation rule now names 'the diagnosis code of the exhausted package, the condition the new package continues', matching the compute anchor; value unchanged.
- O-8 (freeze_cap): bereavement_cap_days 30 -> 21 so the bereavement tier differs from freeze_max_days on every freezable tier; not realised here (surgery tier taken), value unchanged.
- O-4, O-5, O-6, O-7, household-ZIP observation: no change, reasons in the round-2 report (the 'only after' sentence fixes the order; the recipient-package state resolves only to the sale in this world; the recipient gate has no base eligibility entry to cite; transferred visits keep no per-visit expiry in the schema).
- Gates after rework: full block green (see final report).
user_scenario:
You are Renee Okafor, 47, a middle-school science teacher in Greensboro, calling Piedmont Motion's Patient Services line from the school parking lot on your lunch break. You had right knee surgery in early August, and your rehab since then is being done at the clinic under your Blue Cross insurance, so you no longer expect to use the self-pay visit package you bought back in June. Your son Marcus, who is sixteen, plays club soccer and has been coming in for his ankle, and he could use those visits. You open with something like: "Hi, I have one of your prepaid visit packages that I won't be using now, and I'd like to give my leftover visits to my son Marcus." You want it done on this call.

When asked to identify yourself you give your phone number, 3365550147, and your date of birth, 1979-03-22 (you say it as March 22, 1979). If a third detail is wanted you read the account number off a statement, PM-3304718. You can give Marcus's full name, Marcus Okafor, and his birthday, May 9, 2010; you are his mother and he lives with you at the same address, which you confirm if asked. You do not know any reference numbers. You don't remember how many visits are left on your package - "quite a few, I think" - and you ask the agent to look it up.

You are fine with the agent taking care of whatever your package or Marcus needs to make this happen, but you want to hear money figures before anything is charged. If the agent tells you an amount is owed on your package, you listen to the figure and say "Okay, put it on my Visa" - you pay by card - without arguing the amount. If the agent says your package has to come off its hold first, you say that's fine, you're done with the freeze. If the agent explains that Marcus needs an active package of his own to receive the visits, you say he was going to need more visits anyway and ask for the same six-visit package he had before; once you hear the price you pay for it by card. You don't want any other product, plan or change.

You want to make the transfer yourself. When the agent hands the transfer over to you, you carry it out with exactly the package, recipient details and number of visits the agent gives you, and you read back what it shows. Once the agent confirms the visits have moved to Marcus's package, you thank them and end the call. If the agent tells you that no visits can move at all, you ask them once to double-check against your records, and then accept what they say.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The unfreeze (step 10) sets status active and freeze_reason none.

edges.condition: The recipient holds a visit package in active status with a paid installment in its history.

edges.condition: The giving package's history holds a package_payment_received entry of payment kind installment, with its package_visits_credited entry, for every installment whose due date has passed.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The collection (step 8) books installment 3 and credits 8 visits, so balance rises from 8 to 16.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The collection must precede the unfreeze and the transfer, and the unfreeze and the sale must precede the transfer, as the prerequisite sentences state. The sale writes only a new package for Marcus and touches no field or history entry the collection or the unfreeze read or write (Renee's package), and neither of those reads Marcus's records, so placing the sale anywhere before the transfer gives the same terminal state and the same scored values (amount 664.48, expiry_extension_days 66, purchase_price 432.90, visits 8).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the unfreeze the giving package ends frozen with expiry 2027-06-12 instead of active with expiry 2027-08-17 - a different terminal state (transfer from a non-active package).

Without the sale Marcus has no package to receive the visits: the new Recovery package, its payment and credit rows are missing and the transfer has no valid recipient package - a different terminal state.
Skipping the collection leaves the balance at 8, so visits = 8 - 8 = 0 instead of 8 (and no installment payment row).
Skipping the collection limits the freeze days to 8, so expiry_extension_days = 8 + 7 + 2 - 7 = 10 instead of 66.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only giving her leftover visits to her son. It never mentions an unpaid installment, the freeze or a purchase for Marcus; its lines about money owed, coming off hold and Marcus needing an active package are passive reactions that fire only after the agent says so, and it names no policy, tool or prerequisite id.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: In task_tools.py, transfer_package_visits_0bb17a94 writes the transfer and credit entries without reading the giving package's status or the recipient package's status; unfreeze_visit_package_d2f7d693 updates status/expiry without checking installments; draft_package_installment_97c9f1d1 and purchase_visit_package_a542d834 contain no condition at all - none returns an error or hint for an unmet prerequisite.
